description: Kinetic model of the MIC endpoint: how a potency penalty and a finite enzyme half-life multiply into an uncensorable MIC while leaving the short rate-scored assays unaffected
code:
"""
Does the MIC endpoint impose a demand the other three assays do not?

The three surviving candidate explanations after iterations 1-2 are (i) incubation
time / enzyme half-life, (ii) growth-dependent tolerance, (iii) an all-or-none
endpoint with a censoring dilution ceiling.  (i) and (iii) can be written down as
one kinetic model, because the MIC is the only format in which the enzyme must
beat a growing population for most of a day.

Model (explicitly a model with stated parameters, not a measurement):
    dN/dt = mu*N - k*E(t)*N        E(t) = E0 * 2^(-t/t_half)
    K := k*E0  = initial specific lysis rate (1/h)
Integrating:
    ln N(T) = ln N0 + mu*T - K*(t_half/ln2)*(1 - 2^(-T/t_half))
MIC endpoint = no visible growth at T, i.e. N(T) < N_vis.
Turbidity endpoint = initial rate, proportional to k only (mu = 0, washed cells,
10 min, so the decay term is irrelevant).
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

mu      = np.log(2)/0.5      # S. aureus doubling 30 min in rich broth -> 1.386 /h
T       = 20.0               # MIC read at 18-24 h
N0      = 5e5                # CLSI inoculum, CFU/mL
N_vis   = 1e7                # visible turbidity threshold, CFU/mL
ln_head = np.log(N_vis/N0)   # growth the enzyme is allowed to permit

def K_required(t_half, T=T, mu=mu):
    """Initial specific lysis rate needed to hold N(T) below the visible threshold."""
    integ = (t_half/np.log(2))*(1 - 2**(-T/t_half))   # integral of E(t)/E0 dt over 0..T
    need  = mu*T - ln_head
    return need/integ

print("Model parameters: mu = %.3f /h (30 min doubling), T = %.0f h, N0 = %.0e, N_vis = %.0e" % (mu,T,N0,N_vis))
print("Growth the enzyme may permit over 20 h: ln(N_vis/N0) = %.2f (%.0f-fold); unchecked growth = %.1f e-folds\n"
      % (ln_head, N_vis/N0, mu*T))

tab=[]
for th in [0.5,1,2,4,8,16,1e6]:
    tab.append(dict(enzyme_half_life_h=("infinite" if th>1e5 else th),
                    K_required_per_h=round(K_required(th),2),
                    fold_vs_stable_enzyme=round(K_required(th)/K_required(1e6),2)))
TH=pd.DataFrame(tab)
print("=== Lysis rate the MIC demands, as a function of enzyme functional half-life ===")
print(TH.to_string(index=False))

# Combined requirement: potency penalty x stability penalty, expressed as fold of the
# full-length LysK MIC.  Full-length is defined as the construct that just gives a MIC.
t_half_FL = 8.0
pot = np.linspace(1, 20, 160)        # fold loss of specific activity for CHAP-only
thf = np.logspace(np.log10(0.25), np.log10(24), 160)   # CHAP-only functional half-life, h
P, H = np.meshgrid(pot, thf)
FOLD = P * (K_required(H)/K_required(t_half_FL))       # fold of full-length MIC needed

print("\n=== Fold of the full-length LysK MIC that CHAP-only would need ===")
print("(full-length half-life fixed at %.0f h)" % t_half_FL)
for p in [1,5,8.6,10]:
    row=[]
    for h in [0.5,1,2,4,8,24]:
        row.append(round(p*(K_required(h)/K_required(t_half_FL)),1))
    print("  potency penalty %5s x : half-life 0.5/1/2/4/8/24 h -> %s" % (p, row))

print("\nA 2-fold dilution series topping at 8x the full-length MIC reports nothing above 8x.")
print("At the PlyTW-measured 8.6-10x potency penalty, CHAP-only is already past that ceiling")
print("with NO stability loss at all (10.0x at an 8 h half-life).")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15,4.6))

ax = fig.add_subplot(1,3,1)
tt = np.linspace(0,T,400)
for K,lab,c in [(0,"no enzyme","#4a5568"),
                (0.6*K_required(t_half_FL),"CHAP-only at the series ceiling","#c53030"),
                (K_required(t_half_FL),"full-length LysK at its MIC","#2b6cb0")]:
    lnN = np.log(N0) + mu*tt - K*(t_half_FL/np.log(2))*(1-2**(-tt/t_half_FL))
    ax.plot(tt, np.exp(lnN), color=c, lw=2, label=lab)
ax.axhline(N_vis, color="#718096", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(0.4, N_vis*1.3, "visible growth", fontsize=8, color="#4a5568")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylim(1e2,1e12); ax.set_xlabel("Time (h)"); ax.set_ylabel("CFU/mL")
ax.set_title("The MIC endpoint is a threshold:\nthe enzyme must beat the growth rate for 20 h", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="lower right")

ax = fig.add_subplot(1,3,2)
lv=[2,4,8,16,32,64,128]
cs = ax.contourf(P, H, FOLD, levels=lv, cmap="YlOrRd", extend="both")
ax.contour(P, H, FOLD, levels=[8,16,32], colors="k", linewidths=[1.6,1.2,1.0], linestyles=["-","--",":"])
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("Potency penalty of CHAP-only (fold)")
ax.set_ylabel("CHAP-only functional half-life at 37 C (h)")
ax.axvspan(8.6,10.0, color="#2b6cb0", alpha=0.18)
ax.text(9.3, 15, "PlyTW\n8.6-10x", fontsize=7.5, ha="center", color="#2b6cb0")
plt.colorbar(cs, ax=ax, label="fold of full-length MIC required")
ax.set_title("Potency and stability multiply in the MIC.\nSolid/dashed/dotted = 8x, 16x, 32x series ceilings", fontsize=10)

ax = fig.add_subplot(1,3,3)
names=["Zymogram\n(~1 h, dead cells)","Plate lysis\n(overnight, up to 100 uM)",
       "Turbidity\n(10 min, washed cells)","MIC\n(20 h, growing cells)"]
thresh=[1.0,1.0,1.0,10.0*mu/mu]   # relative demand placeholder replaced below
demand=[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0]
rate_scored=[1,1,1,0]
ax.bar(range(4),[1,1,1,0], color="#2f855a", label="rate- or zone-scored (any activity counts)")
ax.bar(range(4),[0,0,0,1], color="#c53030", label="threshold-scored (rate must exceed mu)")
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_ylim(0,1.45)
ax.text(3, 1.08, "needs k*E > %.2f /h\nfor 20 h" % mu, ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#c53030")
for i in range(3): ax.text(i, 1.08, "any k*E > 0\nis detectable", ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#2f855a")
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="upper left")
ax.set_title("What each endpoint scores", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

TH.to_csv("lysK_MIC_threshold_model.csv", index=False)
pd.DataFrame({"potency_penalty_fold": np.repeat(pot[::16],len(thf[::16])),
              "half_life_h": np.tile(thf[::16],len(pot[::16])),
              "fold_of_fullength_MIC_required": (P[::16,::16].T*0 + FOLD[::16,::16].T).ravel()}
            ).to_csv("lysK_MIC_potency_stability_grid.csv", index=False)
print("\nSaved lysK_MIC_threshold_model.csv and lysK_MIC_potency_stability_grid.csv")
